stem: ![](asset:P000239-stem-1)A particle is projected from the base of a plane inclined at an angle of $45{^\circ}$ with the horizontal. The initial velocity of projection is $u$ making an angle of $\theta$ with the horizontal as shown. If the particle strikes the inclined plane horizontally, then what is the value of $\tan \theta$?

assets.alt: A projectile launched with speed u from the foot of an incline of 45°, at angle θ to the incline's surface.
